title: Tavora module manifest (tavora.module.json), apiVersion 1
description: Describes a Tavora module package. Tavora Desktop rejects a manifest with unknown fields instead of ignoring them. The TypeScript validator in @tavora/module-schema is the reference; this schema is checked against it in tests.

$schema.description: Lets editors find this schema. Ignored by Tavora.

id.description: Unique module id: publisher.module-name, lowercase and dot-separated. Never change it after release: data and permissions are keyed on it.

description.description: One or two sentences shown in the module picker.

apiVersion.description: Manifest and bridge contract version. Only "1" exists.

entry.description: HTML page Tavora loads, relative to the package root.

icon.description: Square PNG or WebP icon inside the package, at least 128 × 128 pixels.

games.description: Game ids this module is made for. Empty means any game.

viewport.description: Panel sizes in CSS pixels. Tavora never makes the panel smaller than the minimum.

permissions.description: What the module asks for. Each permission needs the player's grant before it works; the player is asked when they first add the module.

network.description: Exact public host names the module may reach through network.fetch, such as api.example.com. HTTPS only; no scheme, port, wildcard, IP address or local name.

connectors.description: Parts of Tavora that hold a sign-in, which the module asks to use without seeing the token. ai-usage reads the usage of the player's Claude and Codex accounts; discord talks to the Discord app on this PC (voice channels, who is talking, joining and muting).

webAssembly.description: Lets the page compile WebAssembly. Only Tavora's own modules may ask for it; any other module that does is not loaded.

packagePath.description: Relative path inside the package: no leading slash, no '.' or '..' segments, no backslashes or colons.
